what: Welltower is a real-estate investment trust that owns senior housing communities, outpatient medical buildings and post-acute care facilities in the US, Canada and the UK.
customers: Older residents and their families, and the operators and health systems that run its buildings.
money: communities where Welltower shares in the operating profit
moat: Scale and data in a fragmented market, with an ageing population pushing up demand faster than new supply.
opportunities: Revenue grew about 36% last year and about 23% a year over three years
The number of Americans over 80 grows sharply for the next decade
Very little new senior housing has been started since 2020, so supply stays tight
watch: Senior housing occupancy and same-store net operating income growth.
